temples.name: Cave of the Cyclops
temples.blurb: The tutorial. Learn to slide tiles, use stoppers and walk tiles into place.

temples.name: Temple of Flora
temples.blurb: Flowers, fruit and the first real puzzles of the island.

temples.name: Temple of Cupid
temples.blurb: Hearts, roses and the first long stopper chains.

temples.name: Temple of Neptune
temples.blurb: Sea creatures, tray pressure and helpers seven tiles deep.

temples.name: Temple of Venus
temples.blurb: Shells and pearls, and the hardest records so far.

temples.name: Temple of Bacchus
temples.blurb: Grapes and goblets, and pre-placed tiles you may have to lift out first.

temples.name: Temple of Vulcan
temples.blurb: The forge. Blue glue spots hold any tile placed on them forever.
